title: Today
caption: Today opens each time you start OSAP
sub: Weather, warnings, top stories, a daily summary and what is new since your last visit.

title: Today
caption: Pick any country from the list at the top
sub: A red or orange dot means raised recent activity: an automatic count, not a threat rating.

title: Today
caption: The daily summary and top stories
sub: Each item links back to its source, with Zulu and local time.

title: Today
caption: Economy, key dates and travel advisories
sub: Every figure names its source. Government figures are marked as claims.

title: Today
caption: Search the news from the box at the top
sub: Quotes keep a phrase together; a minus sign leaves a word out.

title: Today
caption: Open map takes you to the map

title: The map screen
caption: The map: the open country's reporting, in NATO symbols
sub: The toolbar runs down the right; the grid of the map centre runs along the bottom.

title: The map screen
caption: Set the period: 24 h to All, or Custom
sub: Only reports in the period show on the map and in the lists.

title: The map screen
caption: The title names what you are looking at
sub: Tap it to change the data set.

title: The map screen
caption: The Data badge says how fresh the data is
sub: Green is fresh, amber names any late feed, red means data has stopped.

title: The map screen
caption: Tap a report for its details, source link and fingerprint

title: The map screen
caption: Tap the grid strip to switch MGRS, decimal degrees or DMS

title: Search
caption: Search finds places and grids
sub: MGRS, UTM and lat/long grids work with no signal.

title: Search
caption: It also finds tools, data sets and settings
sub: Everyday words work: "hospital" finds the medical plan.

title: Search
caption: And countries by name or code
sub: On a computer, press / or Ctrl+K to start typing.

title: Data sets
caption: Data sets are the reporting topics
sub: Conflict, crime, natural disasters, public safety, news and more.

title: Data sets
caption: Tick a set to show it on the map; tap its name for its list

title: Data sets
caption: Clear map takes everything off

title: Weather
caption: Weather: radar, satellite rain, cloud, wind, temperature and air quality
sub: Plus cyclones and official warnings.

title: Weather
caption: Model time looks ahead up to 72 hours

title: Weather
caption: Open forecasts and warnings for the full weather view
sub: One-page brief, detailed report and the military-style 5-day chart.

title: Map overlays and base maps
caption: Overlays: map layers that are not reports
sub: Infrastructure, embassies, terrain, aircraft and ships, borders and your own marks.

title: Map overlays and base maps
caption: Infrastructure: communications, power, airfields, ports, bridges and more

title: Map overlays and base maps
caption: Base map: Grey, Streets, Topographic, Satellite, Hybrid and Offline

title: Map overlays and base maps
caption: Grid and Crosshair: MGRS lines that get finer as you zoom in

title: Map overlays and base maps
caption: 3D: tilt and turn the map over real ground

title: Long-press the map
caption: Press and hold anywhere on the map (right-click with a mouse)
sub: A ring of actions opens at that point.

title: Long-press the map
caption: Measure, Route, Point, NAI/TAI, Watch, Plans, Find LZ and Terrain
sub: Copy copies the grid of the point.

title: Long-press the map
caption: Plans: a medical plan or an evacuation plan from here

title: Measure
caption: Tap Measure, then tap the map to add numbered points

title: Measure
caption: Each leg shows its distance and true bearing
sub: Tap point 1 again to close the shape and get its area.

title: Measure
caption: The card lists every leg: true, magnetic and back bearing
sub: Units in km, miles, nautical miles or mils. Profile shows the ground between points.

title: Route and Drive
caption: Route: add waypoints by place, grid, map tap or your location
sub: Drive, Truck, Walk, Cycle or Straight line.

title: Route and Drive
caption: Distance, time, arrival and up to 3 alternatives
sub: Then elevation, light, weather and hazards along the route, and turn-by-turn directions.

title: Route and Drive
caption: Navigate starts turn-by-turn; Preview route steps through pictures
sub: Save as GPX, KML or GeoJSON, or print it.

title: Area, NAI and TAI
caption: Area: Lasso, Polygon, Circle or Square

title: Area, NAI and TAI
caption: A drawn area filters the map and the list to what is inside

title: Area, NAI and TAI
caption: Summarise area, Landing zones, Satellite before/after
sub: Save (NAI/TAI) keeps it with a type, a name and notes.

title: Satellite before/after
caption: Satellite before/after compares two Sentinel-2 passes
sub: From the Area menu, or Overlays > Satellite imagery.

title: Satellite before/after
caption: It lists the passes for the last 90 days with the cloud %
sub: The newest clear pass is After; one about 30 days earlier is Before.

title: Satellite before/after
caption: Side by side, or Swipe on map

title: Points and photos
caption: Point: at the map centre, a tap on the map, or your position

title: Points and photos
caption: Give it a name, a note and an icon
sub: Military symbol, shape or pin. Edits save as you type.

title: Points and photos
caption: Photos keep their original and a SHA-256 fingerprint
sub: Everything stays on this device unless you turn on sync.

title: Watches and alerts
caption: Watch: an area, categories, words and severity
sub: Only new reports count as hits.

title: Watches and alerts
caption: OSAP checks every 15 minutes while open
sub: Push to phone sends alerts through the free ntfy app when OSAP is closed.

title: My work and workspaces
caption: My work: What's new and Saved work

title: My work and workspaces
caption: Save, mark reviewed, add notes and grade reports (A1 to F6)
sub: A grade is always your own choice: OSAP never sets one.

title: My work and workspaces
caption: Workspaces: one per job, with import and export of KML and .zip

title: Team workspace and team cases
caption: Share a workspace with a team by link, or as a team case
sub: Team cases use named accounts with Lead, Analyst and Viewer roles.

title: Team workspace and team cases
caption: Each item shows the call sign of who added it, and when
sub: Viewer links can see but not change: enforced by the team's keys.

title: Team workspace and team cases
caption: In a case, analysts propose entities and links; a lead approves
sub: Nothing is approved by OSAP or by AI.

title: Photo and video check
caption: Photo check reads a picture's metadata on this device
sub: Nothing is uploaded. Missing or faked metadata is normal: treat it as a lead.

title: Photo and video check
caption: Sun and shadow: the sun's direction and height for a place and time
sub: Draw a measured shadow to list the times it fits.

title: Photo and video check
caption: Reverse image search links: Google Lens, Bing, Yandex and TinEye

title: Medical plan
caption: Med plan plans for the map centre or a drawn area
sub: Or long-press, Plans, Med plan from here.

title: Medical plan
caption: Hospitals, most capable first, with drive times against the golden hour
sub: Only capabilities from an official register or your own check count.

title: Medical plan
caption: Status GREEN, AMBER or RED, with a checklist of what is missing
sub: An automatic draft from open data: always call the receiving hospital.

title: Evacuation plan
caption: Evac: set where the people are, then Work out the options

title: Evacuation plan
caption: OSAP routes each option and weighs the incidents near it
sub: This takes a few minutes; the wait is cut from the video.

title: Evacuation plan
caption: Routes to the U.S. embassy or consulate, airports, airfields and seaports
sub: The first choice has the fewest incidents near the route.

title: Evacuation plan
caption: Roles P, A, C, E; legs, corridors, LZs and border crossings
sub: OSAP never marks a route Available: only you do.

title: Landing zone finder
caption: Long-press, then Find LZ
sub: Set the radius, LZ size and maximum slope.

title: Landing zone finder
caption: Up to 8 numbered candidates: clear ground, slope, obstacles and aircraft
sub: Orange means a slope over 7°. Soil, crops and unmapped wires are not checked.

title: Terrain analysis
caption: Long-press, Terrain: viewshed, reverse viewshed, line of sight and more

title: Terrain analysis
caption: Set the heights and range, then CALCULATE

title: Terrain analysis
caption: The ground that can be seen from the point
sub: Terrain only: buildings and trees are not modelled. Grey means no data, not 'not visible'.

title: Comms planning
caption: Comms: Plan, Coverage, Link, Networks, Equipment and Status

title: Comms planning
caption: Will I have phone signal? Likely, Possible, No sign or Unknown
sub: Unknown is never shown as no.

title: Comms planning
caption: Radio link budgets and radio coverage over the ground

title: Comms planning
caption: Masts and each phone network in its own colour

title: Reports: the OSIR
caption: Reports holds every printable report OSAP makes
sub: Country brief, daily summary, weather, timeline, area, medical, route and more.

title: Reports: the OSIR
caption: OSIR: an Open Source Intelligence Report

title: Reports: the OSIR
caption: Choose country, region, topic and dates
sub: Then who prepared it and an optional analyst summary.

title: Reports: the OSIR
caption: Make OSIR

title: Reports: the OSIR
caption: Summary, key events, map and chronology
sub: OSAP adds no judgments. Analyst parts are tagged as the analyst's.

title: Reports: the OSIR
caption: Every record keeps its source link and SHA-256 fingerprint
sub: Print or save as PDF to keep a copy.

title: Conflict tabs
caption: Conflict tabs: one per active conflict worldwide
sub: Reported incidents, deaths by period, sides and history.

title: Conflict tabs
caption: Violence history: small red dots and a heat map

title: Conflict tabs
caption: The Timeline report turns the records into a printable product

title: Settings
caption: The gear: map colours, grid format and distance units

title: Settings
caption: Language, My countries, and the user guide

title: Settings
caption: Offline maps: save a country so OSAP works with no signal

title: Settings
caption: Move to another device, or Sync my devices: no account
sub: Your data is locked on your device with your own passphrase or sync code.

title: Reading what you see
caption: Every report is what a source said
sub: Observed is an instrument reading; Reported is unconfirmed. A trusted source can still be wrong.

title: Reading what you see
caption: Each report links to the original
sub: Machine translated means OSAP translated the headline: check the original.

title: Reading what you see
caption: A record fingerprint (SHA-256) shows the report is the one you saw

title: Reading what you see
caption: AI generated, Automatic and Automatic draft tags
sub: Drafts are never analyst-approved. Times show Zulu first, then local.
